chapter: Haiti, Artie Shaw and Los Angeles work
title: Substitutes at the China Trader and a trip to Mexico with Sammy Davis
summary: Joe Pass, John Gray and Al Viola subbed for Collins at Troup's room while he did outside jobs.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Oh, that was around '68, '67, '68, '69, around in there. In the meantime I was working at the China Trader with Bobby Troop, but I could always leave and come back, and had pretty good subs, like, you know, Joe Pass, John Gray, Al Viola.

Yeah, pretty good subs, you know, they could hold on until I got back. But I could go -- what I'm saying is I could go any place and always go back to Bobby, see. This --I also went to Mexico I told you, I think, with Sammy during this time that I was working with Bobby. Did I mention that?
Yeah, well, with Sammy Davis. But I was working with Bobby Troop then, but I could go any place and it was always my job when I came back. You know. But --
